verdict.rationale: telli documents making audio recording conditional on the caller's consent, so a call is recorded only once they agree. It also documents configurable data retention that automatically deletes contacts and call data once they reach a user-defined age. Together these cover the core of the story, but the disclosure side and the depth of the controls are thin. Missing for 10: documented disclosure-announcement configuration (e.g., spoken recording/AI disclosure scripts), detail on per-call manual recording overrides and retention granularity (per data type or recordings vs. transcripts), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can meet call-recording consent and disclosure obligations with per-call recording controls and configurable data retention

citations.quote: In telli, you can easily make audio recording conditional on the caller's consent — so a call is only recorded once they agree.
Data retention deletes contacts and call data automatically once they reach an age you define.
